name: A Lemonade Stand Up
description: Catch a night of English-language stand-up comedy for a dose of laughter and good vibes to kick off the weekend.
longDescription:
"A Lemonade Stand Up" is an evening of English-language stand-up comedy, presented by local comedians. The event aims to provide a regular platform for comedic talent in Porto, fostering a community for both performers and audiences interested in international comedy. It is a recurring fixture in the city's nightlife calendar, offering a consistent opportunity to see live comedy.

Attendees can expect an evening of humor and a relaxed atmosphere. The show typically features a lineup of several comedians, each performing a set, with the total duration usually around 90 minutes to two hours. The audience is generally a mix of locals and international residents, drawn by the English language format. Nope Pelmeni & Dumplings Bar provides an intimate setting for the performances.

The event takes place on 2026-04-23. Ticket prices vary and can be purchased at the venue or in advance. Nope Pelmeni & Dumplings Bar is located in central Porto, within walking distance of Trindade metro station.
